NFL Season Begins with Unpredictable Championship Odds

The National Football League (NFL) season commenced on Wednesday, marking the start of a new competitive year. The path to the Super Bowl is considered unpredictable following an offseason characterized by significant changes in team rosters, coaching staff, and overall championship probabilities. This season's outlook suggests a wide-open race for the championship.
